headline: FTV Q2 Deep Dive: Organic Growth, Margin Expansion, and Strategic Product Investments
summary: Industrial technology company Fortive (NYSE:FTV) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.9% year on year to $1.10 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.74 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
